olevel_requirement: Five (5) SSC credit passes or TC II merits including English Language, Literature in English and a Nigerian Language preferably Edo. 'O' Level pass in Mathematics is optional.
direct_entry: (i) Two (2) 'A' Level passes in GCE or HSC or a recognised equivalent in any two (2) Arts subjects. (ii) NCE in any two (2) Arts subjects with an overall Merit level pass.

institution_waivers.note: Accepts 'O' Level pass in English Language for candidates with 'O' Level distinction pass in Literature in English.
